name: What a task create and a task change take over HTTP
summary: ApiHandler._task_change refuses a task PATCH the route cannot carry out before the idempotency key is reserved: a field other than title, description, status (plus version and actor) answers 422 naming it and what the route takes, as does a body that changes nothing or a status other than open and closed, so the same key serves the corrected request. EndpointBackend._command never builds a bd update with nothing in it (bd answers that with words and exit 0, which read as an unknown outcome). _bind_task_actor binds an actor in the body of task create and task change with Service.bind_actor, as claim, checkpoint and review do.
